name: Personal Assistant
tagline: Clears calendar clashes, bills, trips and paperwork one approved step at a time
description: Takes whatever life admin is stuck on your desk - a double-booked week, an unpaid bill, a trip that needs booking, a form that needs filling, a question that needs answering - and hands back one clear next step plus the drafts to carry it out. Nothing is sent, spent, deleted or published until you say yes.
author: Gabriel
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
